messages:
jess: Hey team — escalating a billing complaint from ACME. They were charged twice for what they say was one user action. Invoice shows two token events but customer only made one request. Ticket #34210.

mike: Can you drop the sample request/headers and any request_id / ledger ids? @eng-ingress — sounds like a retry + idempotency gap.

jess: From the customer's support dump:
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
client_request_id: acme-req-20260212-01
User-Agent: acme-sdk/1.2.3
# Note: NO Idempotency-Key header present
{...payload...}
```
They included two ledger refs in the ticket: ledger_inc_15432, ledger_inc_15433.

devon: I pulled meter logs. There are two token-write events for that client_request_id ~2.1s apart. Both events contain full token counts.

mike: Gateway logs show upstream returned 504 for the first attempt -> gateway retried once (policy: retry-on-timeout). The gateway generated a new internal replay id and forwarded the same payload. Because the client didn't set an `Idempotency-Key` we didn't have a client-supplied stable key to dedupe.

devon: Important detail: our current meter path increments the ledger as soon as the request reaches ingest, before we run the idempotency/dedupe step. So if the request is replayed, we end up counting twice.

mike: Repro steps I ran locally: send a request without Idempotency-Key, simulate upstream 504, gateway retries once. Observe two ledger writes.

mike: Quick mitigation options:
- stop automatic gateway-level retries for cases where client_request_id present but no Idempotency-Key (fast rollback)
- short-term: make ledger write check for duplicate client_request_id and skip second write (cheap patch)
- long-term: move dedupe check earlier or require Idempotency-Key for clients hitting high-throughput endpoints

tara: Billing will issue a manual credit while eng fixes this. Please add the invoice ids and confirmed credit amount to the ticket once done.

devon: I'll open a patch: add a pre-meter dedupe check keyed on `client_request_id` (exists in most SDKs) and add metrics to ensure we don't undercount. Rolling to canary in us-west1 now.

jess: Noted — customer updated: we confirmed duplicate charge and will credit immediately, tracking fix as P1. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket #34210 status -> escalated to eng-ingress; billing action pending (credit issued).
